purpose: Improve minority-class recommendation detection without opening final tests
inner_split: StratifiedGroupKFold on training records only; groups are private HMAC authors, falling back to review ID
threshold_source: Training-only out-of-fold negative-class scores; maximize macro F1, then negative F1, then proximity to 0.5
selection: Choose the candidate with highest validation macro F1, breaking ties by negative F1, then negative precision, then fewer features. No test selection.
